sources.title: Immigration Regulations, 2009 (current Parliament-hosted file)
sources.publisher: Nitijela (Parliament), Republic of the Marshall Islands
sources.officialityEvidence: Nitijela's live legislation index links this Parliament-hosted regulatory text. Section 6 makes the visitor-visa route turn on diplomatic ties.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visitor Visas, to citizens of Countries which the Republic has diplomatic ties with.

sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of the Marshall Islands: consular visa information
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Washington, D.C.
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Embassy consular page states the current visitor-visa rule and says the Foreign Ministry updates the diplomatic-relations list. Its linked country summary returned HTTP 404 on review, so it is not used as a current list.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of the countries that have diplomatic relations with the Republic of the Marshall Islands will be granted Visa On Arrival.
